turns.content: Hey, I just moved into my new place in Austin last weekend. Still surrounded by boxes.
Congrats on the move! How are you settling into Austin so far?
Pretty good. My dog Biscuit is confused by the new backyard but he'll adjust. Also work is busy, we're migrating a warehouse at Meridian Labs and I'm the only data engineer on it.
Sounds hectic. What's the migration target?
Snowflake to ClickHouse. My manager Priya thinks we can cut costs by half. I'm skeptical but we'll see.
